newsitem.title: USA: Clinton opens door to slavery apology to blacks.
newsitem.headline: Clinton opens door to slavery apology to blacks.

text.p: President Clinton left the door open Sunday to backing a proposed apology to black Americans whose ancestors were brought to the United States as slaves.
Clinton, who launched a new drive for racial reconciliation and dialogue over the weekend, said he wanted more time to think about the proposal by a dozen white lawmakers for a congressional apology.
